notes.title: And we have 20 new levels and Spanish version!
notes.content:
It's been a month already since we've released, big thanks to everyone who's been playing!

We're celebrating this anniversary with 20 new levels over an additional mechanics (watch out, some of those pre-placed pieces rotate!). And we're also adding a Spanish version (sorry, my Spanish is not good enough to put a message in it as well)
